name: memory-retrieval-v1
description: Retrieval quality fixture for the memory search index: 12 bilingual ordinary memories + 16 queries with expected id sets. FTS mode runs offline in CI behind a recall@5 gate (default 0.7) and a blind-spot check (every query must surface at least one expected id in the top-5 — a load-bearing keyword going missing turns the gate red). The --hybrid variant needs the local embedding model and writes to the .harness/evals ledger instead of gating CI. Chinese queries quote the FULL contiguous CJK run from the memory text so both the trigram and unicode61 tokenizers match them.

memories.title: csv dedupe before merge
memories.summary: 整理季度报告前先去重。
memories.content:
dedupe csv rows before merging quarterly reports; never merge blind.

整理季度报告前先去重，绝不盲并。

memories.title: deploy notification to ops
memories.content:
send the deployment notification to the ops channel after every release.

每次发布后向运维频道发送部署通知。

memories.title: virtualenv before pip install
memories.summary: 装依赖前先建虚拟环境。
memories.content:
always create a virtualenv before pip install; freeze the resolved versions into requirements.txt.

装依赖前先建虚拟环境，冻结版本。

memories.title: powershell UTF8 output encoding
memories.summary: 脚本必须设置 UTF8 输出编码。
memories.content:
powershell scripts must set UTF8 output encoding, otherwise Chinese output garbles.

PowerShell 脚本必须设置 UTF8 输出编码，否则中文乱码。

memories.title: rebase feature branches
memories.content:
prefer git rebase over merge for feature branches; never force push the main branch.

特性分支优先变基，绝不强推主干。

memories.title: enable WAL journal mode
memories.summary: SQLite 开启 WAL 模式。
memories.content:
enable WAL journal mode for the embedded sqlite database so a hard process kill never corrupts it.

内嵌数据库开启 WAL 模式，硬杀进程也不会损坏。

memories.title: failing test first
memories.summary: 先写失败的测试再修代码。
memories.content:
write the failing test first, then change the code until the suite passes.

先写一个失败的测试，再改代码直到通过。

memories.title: truncate tool output with evidence pointer
memories.summary: 截断工具输出并保留证据指针。
memories.content:
truncate long tool output head and tail, and keep an evidence pointer so the full text stays recoverable.

超长工具输出头尾截断，保留证据指针以便回查全文。

memories.title: docker compose volumes are destructive
memories.content:
docker compose down with -v wipes the volumes; always confirm before running it.

compose 清理会连同卷一起删除，运行前必须确认。

memories.title: excel serial dates via openpyxl
memories.summary: excel 日期是序列号需转换。
memories.content:
import excel with openpyxl; dates arrive as serial numbers, convert them on read.

用 openpyxl 导入 excel，日期是序列号，读取时需要转换。

memories.title: cursor pagination on list apis
memories.content:
the list api paginates at 100 items per page; follow the cursor until it comes back empty.

列表接口每页 100 条，跟游标翻页直到为空。

memories.title: back up before forward-only migrations
memories.content:
back up the database file before running forward-only migrations; there is no rollback path.

迁移前先备份数据库，正向迁移没有回滚路径。
